name: bell-lab
title: Bell Lab
description: Sweep θ over the |Ψ2(θ)> family and check concurrence C2 = η (paper Eq. 13-14).

files./apps/bell-lab/main.qsh:
# Bell Lab: C2 = eta along the |Psi2(theta)> family
echo == Bell Lab ==
run bell_apqb 0.1 --shots 256 --seed 1
ent last
run bell_apqb 0.4 --shots 256 --seed 1
ent last
run bell_apqb 0.25pi --shots 256 --seed 1
ent last
echo done: C2^2 + r^2 = 1 at every theta
files./apps/bell-lab/README.txt: Bell Lab runs bell_apqb at three angles and prints the concurrence of each state.
